title: Italian Haloumi, Corn & Cheese Fritters
subtitle: with Roast Potatoes & Salad
description: Corn fritters get a boost with mild curry spices and a fresh salad on the side! Fried golden brown and oh‑so‑delicious, these sweet and savoury morsels haloumi bring loads of flavour and fun to the table.

steps.text:
•

• Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan-forced.
• Cut potato into bite-sized chunks and place on the lined oven tray. Season with salt and drizzle with olive oil.
• Toss to coat and roast until tender, 20-25 mins. 
• In a medium bowl, place haloumi and cover with water to soak.

•

• Meanwhile, thinly slice brown onion. Drain corn. Grate carrot. Using a paper towel, squeeze out any moisture from the carrot. Drain haloumi and pat dry. Cut the haloumi into 1cm-thick slices.
• In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat.
• Cook haloumi until golden brown, 1-2 mins each side. Transfer to a plate.
• In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat. Cook onion until tender, 4-5 mins.
• In a medium bowl, combine corn, carrot, cooked onion, pesto-flavoured powder, Cheddar cheese, the plain flour, egg, milk and a pinch of pepper (if it's too wet, add more flour).

•

• Return pan to medium-high heat and add enough olive oil to coat the base. • When oil is hot, cook heaped spoonfuls of fritter mixture, flattening with a spatula, until golden, 3-4 mins each side (don't flip too early!). You should get 3-4 fritters per person. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.

•

• Roughly chop tomato. In a medium bowl, combine the honey and a drizzle of vinegar and olive oil. Add tomato and salad leaves and toss to coat. Season.
• Divide fritters, haloumi, potatoes and salad between plates. Serve with dill & parsley mayo.
